newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-AMERICAN BANNED FOR KICKING OPPONENT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AMERICAN BANNED FOR KICKING OPPONENT.

text.p: United States flanker Jay Wilkerson has been suspended by his own coach for kicking Wales hooker Garin Jenkins during his side's 34-14 defeat at Cardiff Arms Park on Saturday
Wilkerson, 30, received a four-week ban after U.S. coach and manager Jack Clark watched a video recording of the 52nd minute incident.
"I have never been involved in anything like this before, and I wholeheartedly regret the incident," Wilkerson said. "I've spoken to Garin, and I sincerely apologise. I accept my union's decision."
